feedback: The geometry with a wider wheel track of 0.18 and rear sensors positioned at y = -0.035 continues to provide good lateral stability and early line detection, which helps reduce off-track failures. However, the controller still struggles to fully exploit this geometry, as evidenced by persistent line loss events and failure to complete the track. The controller had to compensate by increasing gains and sensor weights to improve responsiveness and control authority. To further improve, consider slightly increasing the sensor y-positions of the rear sensors to -0.04 or -0.045 to detect the line even earlier on sharp turns, and possibly increase sensor size to 0.012 or 0.016 if noise robustness allows, to improve signal quality. Also, a minor increase in wheel track beyond 0.18 is not possible due to constraints, but exploring slight forward shifts in rear sensor x-positions (e.g., from 0.02 to 0.025) might help earlier detection without compromising stability.
requested_changes: sensor_positions[5].y to -0.04 or -0.045 for earlier rear detection
sensor_size to 0.012 or 0.016 if noise robustness allows
sensor_positions[5].x and [6].x to 0.025 and -0.025 for earlier detection
